hugh.name: Master Hugh
hugh.role: Senior keeper; careful, proud, slowly learning to trust outsiders

simon.name: Simon
simon.role: Junior keeper; dry humor, kind, annoyed that knowledge is kept from people who need it

sl.hugh.hello.text: These halls hold dangerous knowledge. A locked door didn't keep the Legion out.

choices.text: The Legion is already using it. Help me stop them.
You still care about rules? Look around.
What can I do to help?

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.need.text: You helped our people. Keeping this door shut won't protect them now.

effects.title: Knowledge under guard
effects.text: The reading halls are open. Find the Legion orders, then release the seal at the far end. The guardian still stands between you and the orb.

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.cold.text: Demanding dangerous knowledge won't earn my trust.

choices.text: I am afraid for the people back home. That came out badly.
Let me prove I will take care of this place.

effects.title: Another way inside
effects.text: A service passage runs below the west side of Hugh’s desk. Its latch can be opened from below. Hugh can also be approached again.

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.wait.text: The service workers know how to get past broken doors without my permission.

choices.text: Tell me about the damaged records.

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.records.text: Move the loose pages onto the dry desk in the east records room, away from the broken window.

choices.text: I will take care of it.

effects.title: Save the loose pages
effects.text: Use the rising east walkway. Lift the fallen records onto the dry desk, then tell Hugh they are safe.

choices.text: The pages are safe on the desk.

effects.title: Knowledge under guard
effects.text: The reading halls are open. Find the Legion orders, then release the seal at the far end. The guardian still stands between you and the orb.

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.open.text: Follow the central aisle through the reading hall. The guardian beyond still attacks anyone who approaches.

choices.text: What should I ask the orb?

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.hugh.orb.text: The orb allows one clear question. Ask what you came to learn.

choices.text: How can we stop the Abyss King?

effects.title: The question that matters
effects.text: You came to Sunspire to learn how to stop the Abyss King. Reach the orb beyond the guardian. Hugh warns that it answers one clear question.

voice.speaker: hugh
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.hello.text: Welcome to the restricted shelves. The Legion has made a mess of our rules.

choices.text: Why did they take the library?

effects.title: Wings Above the Clouds
effects.text: A dragon is trapped on the western nesting terraces beyond the empty displays. Find the supply ledge below its winch. The main path can wait, but the rescue is optional.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.shelf.text: A shard is behind the turning shelves. Handles move shelves and bridges together. Read the guide's arrows.

effects.title: The turning shelves
effects.text: Three handles turn the shelf bridges. The guide beside them shows their directions. Match all three to reach the far shelf and its Rift Shard.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.hint.text: First toward sunrise. Next toward Hugh. Last away from sunrise. Follow the gold tips, not the book spines.

choices.text: That gives me enough to try.

effects.title: Simon’s hint
effects.text: Set the first gold tip east, the second south, and the third west. North is toward the guardian door. The handles keep turning one step at a time.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.legion.text: The Legion wants our maps and spells. We should have shared this knowledge before they seized it.

choices.text: What happened to the empty displays?

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.frames.text: A senior scholar threw the training rifts from Sunspire to save them. Their scattered shards can restore the lessons inside.

effects.title: The frames that fell
effects.text: A scholar threw the crystalline training rifts from Sunspire to keep them from the Legion. Their pieces scattered across Aerth. The Rift Hall can restore their training paths.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.stands.text: Activate one archive seal at a time. Defeat its guards and secure the stand before the gold marks fade. Failed attempts can be retried.

effects.title: Protect the archive
effects.text: Activate an archive stand, defeat its three guards within forty seconds, then secure the stand. Repeat for the other two. Failed stands can be retried; completed stands stay safe during this attempt.

choices.text: Is that a shard behind the last stand?

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

sl.simon.reward.text: Save the records, then collect the shard inside the archive seal.

choices.text: I will try to be more specific.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.

dr.simon.nest.text: A young dragon is trapped on the western terraces. Follow the ledge beyond the empty displays.

choices.text: How do I get it out safely?

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Optional Sky Library nesting rescue. The living dragon is not Hollowed. The player helps before expecting a reward.

dr.simon.safe.text: Get spare beams and dried meat from the lower supply ledge. Brace the cracked frame before turning the winch, then climb up and release the net.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Optional Sky Library nesting rescue. The living dragon is not Hollowed. The player helps before expecting a reward.

dr.simon.joke.text: It ate part of the rulebook. The staff liked that.

choices.text: I think we will get along.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Optional Sky Library nesting rescue. The living dragon is not Hollowed. The player helps before expecting a reward.

dr.simon.free.text: The dragon trusts you. Give it room and finish the reading halls together. The Beastkeeper can help afterward.

voice.speaker: simon
voice.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Use the current concise wording.
voice.context: Optional Sky Library nesting rescue. The living dragon is not Hollowed. The player helps before expecting a reward.

effects.title: Knowledge under guard
effects.text: The reading halls are open. Find the Legion orders, then release the seal at the far end. The guardian still stands between you and the orb.

effects.title: A door without a title
effects.text: The service latch opens the reading halls. The people who maintained this place always had their own way in.

effects.title: Pages saved
effects.text: The loose pages are on the dry desk. Hugh can now see you came to help.

effects.title: Keep the orb beyond reach
effects.text: The Legion orders say to keep all visitors away from the orb. The guardian has been turned against anyone who approaches. Defeat the reading hall patrol, then release the seal at the guardian door.

effects.title: The guardian door
effects.text: The seal is released. Crossing into the guardian hall secures this half’s Rift Shards. Finish any exploring you want to do first.

effects.title: The frames that fell
effects.text: A scholar’s last note: “I threw the training rifts over the edge. Better scattered in the hands of strangers than whole in the hands of the Legion.” Their broken mounts remain here.

effects.title: The hidden display
effects.text: The sun-lamp still shines. Grip the wing-shaped reflector and walk it along the rail. Hold its beam on the sword seal to open the hidden display.

effects.title: The shelf guide
effects.text: Each handle turns two shelves: its own and the next one. The third also turns the first. Match the gold pointers to the pale marks carved beside them. The return lever resets all three. Once aligned, the shelves lock and the stepping platforms extend.

effects.title: Archive stand 1 saved
effects.text: The seal is stable and the records are safe. The other stands can be defended in any order.

effects.title: Archive stand 2 saved
effects.text: The seal is stable and the records are safe. The other stands can be defended in any order.

effects.title: Archive stand 3 saved
effects.text: The seal is stable and the records are safe. The other stands can be defended in any order.

effects.title: The cracked frame
effects.text: The keeper’s notice warns: brace the cracked frame before lowering the net. Spare beams and dried meat are stored on the lower ledge. Unfasten the net from the high nest only when the ropes hang loose.

effects.title: A beam for the frame
effects.text: Carry the spare beam to the cracked frame on the winch terrace. It will hold the weight while the net is lowered.

effects.title: A quiet offer
effects.text: Dried meat may help the frightened dragon trust you. First free it, then offer the food and step back.

effects.title: The frame is steady
effects.text: The beam holds. Drive off the Legion handlers, then turn the winch to lower the net slowly.

effects.title: Loose ropes
effects.text: The net is lowered safely. Climb the narrow upper ledge and unfasten it beside the dragon.

effects.title: Room to breathe
effects.text: The dragon is free. A fallen service bridge now leads back from the winch terrace to the displays. Offer the dried meat at the nest, then step back.

effects.title: An unexpected friend
effects.text: The dragon accepts your help. Finish Sky Library and enter the guardian hall to keep your new companion. Then select Sunspire Dragon at the Beastkeeper. Leaving or dying before that loses this rescue.
